job.title: Senior Engineer, Security Automation
job.pay_full: $144,800 – $181,000 a year in eligible states with published ranges (CO, HI, IL, MD outside the DC area, MA, MN, VT); pay elsewhere discussed during hiring; may also be eligible for Twilio's equity and corporate bonus plans

details.about: Twilio's communications platform serves hundreds of thousands of businesses and millions of developers, and the company works remote-first. This role joins Twilio's Information Security Team to help it run more efficiently by improving and automating critical security workflows, working across the full software development life cycle and owning automated workflows for cloud security, product security, governance, risk and compliance (GRC) and enterprise security.
duties: Build automated and AI-powered security solutions for Twilio's cloud and enterprise infrastructure, using data orchestration frameworks and LLM-based approaches
Build workflows that bring structured and unstructured data into orchestrated pipelines for decision-making and risk reduction
Design and prototype LLM-driven applications for security analysis, incident response and governance tasks
Work with cross-functional teams to find security needs and deliver solutions
Help define the security automation and AI roadmap
Own the operational health of the team's automation and AI systems against SLOs and KPIs
Support on-call for the team's tools, pipelines and models
needs: At least 5 years as a software engineer developing internal tools and automating workflows at scale
Proficiency in Python (or another scripting language)
Hands-on experience applying AI/ML models, including LLMs, to automate business or security processes
Solid understanding of software security principles, secure coding and security automation
Experience with data orchestration frameworks such as Airflow, Dagster or Prefect
Familiarity with Terraform, CI/CD systems (BuildKite or similar) and Kubernetes/Docker
Strong problem-solving, communication and collaboration skills
nice: Experience with Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (SOAR) and scaling automated incident response
Experience automating and scaling GRC workflows
Experience designing reusable security automation frameworks
details.benefits: Published base pay ranges by location: $144,800 – $181,000 (Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland outside the DC area, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont); $153,280 – $191,600 (New York and New Jersey outside the NYC area, Washington State outside the Seattle area, Washington D.C. and its area, Maryland, California outside the San Francisco Bay Area); $170,320 – $212,900 (San Francisco Bay Area, NYC area, Seattle area). The two higher ranges cover only locations where this role cannot be hired. Pay elsewhere is discussed during hiring. The role may be eligible for Twilio's equity and corporate bonus plans, and all roles get health care insurance, a 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off and paid parental leave.
notes: Remote, but not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA or the Washington D.C. area
Occasional travel for in-person team or project meetings
Applications are intended to be accepted until December 21, though this may change

yt_title: Twilio Is Hiring: Senior Engineer, Security Automation | Remote US | $144K–$181K

scenes.head: Today's job
lines: Welcome to Veritas Recruitment Agency, where we bring you real tech jobs straight from employers' own careers sites.
Today, Twilio is hiring a Senior Engineer for Security Automation, a remote role in the United States.
You'll find the direct application link in the description.

scenes.head: About Twilio
lines: Twilio powers customer communications for hundreds of thousands of businesses and millions of developers, and it works remote-first.
This role joins the Information Security team, helping it run more efficiently by automating its most important security workflows.

scenes.head: What you'll do
bullets: Orchestrate data pipelines for risk decisions
lines: You'll build automated security tools, including ones powered by large language models, to protect Twilio's cloud and enterprise systems.
You'll pull structured and unstructured data into orchestrated pipelines, and prototype tools that speed up security analysis, incident response, and governance work.
You'll also help shape the security automation roadmap, keep these systems reliable, document how they work, and support on-call.

scenes.head: What you need
bullets: 5+ yrs as a software engineer automating workflows
lines: You'll need at least five years as a software engineer building internal tools and automating workflows at scale, and strong Python or another scripting language.
You also need hands-on experience applying machine learning models, including large language models, to automate processes, plus a solid grasp of secure coding.
And experience with orchestration frameworks like Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect, along with Terraform, C I C D, Kubernetes, and Docker.
Experience with security orchestration tools or compliance automation is a plus.

It's remote, but can't be hired in California, Connecticut, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Washington State, or the Washington D C area.
